sources.title: Cost to Build a Daycare Center ($150–$450/SF)

notes.startup_cost_figures: Home $7K, group home ~$18K, center ~$484K are itemized MODELED benchmarks built from industry line items + Terrapin build cost, NOT vendor quotes. Confirm locally.
notes.tuition: Chicago center tuition from Willow Tree (Bucktown/Logan Sq) actual Jan 2026 pricing; IL averages from LadyBug 2026. Chicago sits at top of state range.
notes.licensing: DCFS license is FREE and valid 3 years; centers get 6-month conditional license first. Budget separately for background checks, health exams, radon, fire inspections.
